name: Bind generic external admission candidate and make replay/recovery fail closed

files_create.purpose: Scoped high-risk repair contract and later reviewer reference.
Command captures and independent verdicts; preserve source input separation.

files_modify.purpose: Require host-selected expected candidate digest, validate before replay, recover identical orphan admission only after all current checks; reconciliation detects orphan/corrupt records. Validate allocation identifiers using existing safe_token contract before path construction.
Add adversarial tests for digest, replay tamper and failed persistence; adapt direct/CLI callers for required expected digest.
Update installed consumer CLI caller to supply trusted expected candidate digest; retain mandatory conformance.
Document existing optional admission API, new required host expected digest and token/replay/recovery trust boundary.
Record current-source correction and NF07 boundary without claiming installed adoption/release.
Declare profile version 1.1.0 for whole-envelope authenticated binding; old proof semantics are not silently accepted.

non_goals: No embedded .nizam changes, version/tag publication, live installation or paid run.
No new controller/ledger/attempt authority or Agentic dependency.
No claim that HMAC/token possession authenticates independent producer identity or sandbox isolation.
No weakening historical acceptance, rewriting old receipts or auto-granting retries.
No inventing candidate SHA256 encoding: the active trusted host supplies expected_candidate_sha256 using its already-frozen candidate manifest.
acceptance_requirements: Existing generic optional permit API is reused; current source provides a canonical profile, unlike old release-only absence inventory.

Permit allocation validates task/step/run IDs against the existing schema safe_token bounds before creating state or filesystem paths; traversal, overlong and non-string identities refuse with no filesystem effects.

Admission requires trusted expected_candidate_sha256 out of band; missing API/CLI argument refuses; mismatch refuses before any state transition. Existing caller digest is only a declared value until compared to independently selected host expected digest.

Identical replay revalidates current expected policy/framework/candidate/contract/collections/tool and all artifact bytes plus stored record integrity before returning; tampered evidence or changed expected policy refuses without counters changing.

If admission file publication succeeds but ledger write fails, reconcile reports unresolved orphan (not ok). Repeating exact valid admission revalidates all inputs and uses identical retained record before one ledger transition; conflicting orphan remains untouched and refuses.
Reconciliation validates stored envelope digest rather than trusting its declared digest, detects unmatched admission/permit files and preserves them for explicit recovery.

Real adverse controls include candidate mismatch, replay artifact/contract/policy and record mutation, allocation/admission persistence interruption and retry/concurrency; existing ceilings and standalone API behavior remain passing.
Source acceptance is separate from neutral-profile conformance, installed adoption and Agentic A08/A09/J01 qualification.

Independent evaluator splice finding requires producer HMAC to bind every semantically relevant envelope field, including assessed digest/policy/framework/contract/collections/attempt/status metadata. Use domain-separated full-envelope authentication excluding only producer_proof itself, plus existing producer identity/timestamp. Old profile 1.0.0 refuses; current profile 1.1.0 and required helper argument documented. Preserve original conformance corpus; only explicit metadata projection in current static test is allowed.

verification.acceptance_test: Installed standalone consumer exercise and mandatory refusal controls
Existing current root typed QA/receipt regression inventory

approval_evidence.root_authority: Root instruction 2026-10-30: approves contract status advancement with both bound precode records; proceed test-first.

remaining_issues_outside_scope: Producer credential/channel trust requires selected host integration; SHA256/HMAC alone does not establish independence.
Concurrent in-process mutation by privileged host code is outside envelope data validation threat model.
NF01-NF06 broader root-source controls still require their own recorded suite coverage.
evidence_convention: Exact command argv/cwd/base/candidate/environment, true exits and immutable stdout/stderr captures; independent verdicts separate from assessed source inputs.
compatibility_note: The library admit_external_evidence call requires a new keyword expected_candidate_sha256 and CLI --expected-candidate-sha256. Missing values refuse rather than preserve unsafe legacy acceptance. Update both authored current callers and document this source-only compatibility change. The host supplies its independently approved frozen-manifest digest; never obtain the expected value from the submitted envelope.
